concreteCorrections.finding: Both proposals depend on helpers that may reconstruct condition journals and advance a temporary ledger. Their general read-only statements are insufficient as a callable purity contract. The parent CONDITION_READ_BOUNDARY.md already contains the right proposed restriction; family descriptors should reference it explicitly before extraction. This is not a claim that either proposal has implemented or approved a lazy read.
concreteCorrections.proposedCorrection: Add an explicit shared conditionReadDependency referencing CONDITION_READ_BOUNDARY.md and actual GPT04. New V1 assessment/discovery/domain/cost helpers require the exact owner/current-state NativeReadContextV1 (proposed name), consume already-materialized journal-time/current projections at the native marker/mode, and return technical unavailable if absent/mismatched. No legacy ConditionResolutionScope.Read/Project fallback, Restore, AdvanceTo, semantic fold, lifecycle repair or historical-event substitution. Do not add a new global condition/capability rejection to native interrupt/cancel paths that bypass such checks. Current actor/owner/consent permissions remain independently checked. Apply actual GPT05 public CLR/internal-constructor accessibility, explicit projection Stamp reference binding, private generation ownership, same-generation atomic publication and trusted non-reentrant provider corrections.
concreteCorrections.acceptanceStatus: Actual GPT04 architecture and GPT05 bounded read-context direction concurred. GPT05 member/accessibility/stamp/publication corrections must be incorporated. Full transitive audit and HC remain OPEN; no runtime authorization.

representationDecisionsToRetainOpen.finding: Positive nutrition and counted-lot quantities correctly use the actual ResourceLot.UnitId, including TEST_ONLY.ration-pound and prototype.potable-water.pint. Fixed Amount=1 for a physical whole item and Amount=0 for trap retrieval are native request scalars, not automatically a ResourceLot mass unit. The current human labels one indivisible target item / one bound specimen are not registered native unit identities.
representationDecisionsToRetainOpen.proposedDisposition: When mapping these fixed parameter values to the proposed V1 Quantity response, explicitly register a nonphysical native command-scalar dimension or represent them under a precisely reviewed fixed-sentinel descriptor. Keep the raw existing InventoryRequest unchanged. Do not reinterpret specimen1 as1pound, trap0 as absent/positive quantity, or manufacture a native unit ID. This is a response-encoding decision, not a new rule. Actual GPT05 requires exactly one native unit or registered technical dimension. Its explicit CopperValue approval does not itself register the whole-item/trap-sentinel request dimension.

representationDecisionsToRetainOpen.finding: The magic text distinguishes native constructor domains from selected positive/denied routes, but does not use the physical/common explicit domainKind vocabulary consistently.
representationDecisionsToRetainOpen.proposedDisposition: Normalize at the parent registry: source spell IDs, elected bool/enum values and selected level2/3 arrays are FiniteComplete; targets are current authorized finite sets if actually enumerated; Consecrate coordinate examples are illustrative constrained signed Int32 geometry unless the complete authorized cell domain is enumerated. Do not call broad ValidId or coordinate extrema a complete valid target set.

positiveChecks.finding: Command defaults Target empty/X0/Y0/null optional requests, InventoryRequest required Amount with Destination empty/Handling Pickup defaults, typed SpellCast defaults, Consecrate getter payload and advancement constructor receipt distinctions match inspected source. Both proposals expressly forbid turning canonical null examples into a new global payload rejection.

No invented food/water quantum: ordinary portion/intake are constrained positive exact rationals with current stock bound. Native counted inventory specifically requires denominator1. Whole-item and trap-zero sentinels are separate variants, not a global positive-amount constructor restriction.

InterruptIntake uses actual own job identity without a new stock-owner permission; Wound interrupt uses patient target and returns before new-start access/material checks; ShortRest interruption retains native pending gate; LongRest interruption returns before new-start access/pending checks. The physical proposal preserves these distinctions.

Food900seconds/pound and water60seconds/pint are reservation duration rates; StartIntake does not instantly credit them. ShortRest3600 and LongRest28800 are work reservations with later actual completion; ordinary physical handling1second is distinct from tactical Action/interaction payment. Consecrate expiry18seconds outside initiative versus local+3*orderCount in initiative and3-own-start recharge are source cadence, not caller inputs or guaranteed future outcome.

Stabilization elected Guidance alone derives .medicine (9chars,max87); typed spell casts check .effect even for nonpersistent spell; non-None Radiance/Invocation cure capacity checks longest .radiance.cure/.radiance.sync and .invocation.cure/.invocation.sync forms. Magic max57 arithmetic has adequate suffix room for those enumerated paths and does not certify other families.

Rite null vs explicit None remain different fingerprints. Advancement legacy pair/list/ASI/settlement receipt types are not silently rewritten; exact selected level2/3 choices remain atomic earned advancement.

AcquireEarnedSpell remains an exposed denial with no free acquisition; trap Abandon/cache key existence does not become host admission; vessel Retrieve/Stow retain denied native branch; class-recovery short-rest candidate is not upgraded; no pending offer, owner permission or supported save is invented.
